Subscription inventory correctly preserves distinct list/sender keys, but the consumer renderer drops that identity and shows only displayName; additionally the destructive Health cleanup path selects a row by key in the browser but sends only sender address/domain to the API/worker, so two distinct list identities sharing a sender can be cleaned together.
